SELECT s.id, s.name, s.mode, s.app_id, s.store_id, s.warehouse_id, s.customer_id, s.return_address_id, s.stock_sync_enabled, s.safety_stock, s.stock_sync_interval, s.order_sync_enabled, s.auto_create_order, s.status, s.stock_synced_at, s.order_synced_to, s.aftersale_synced_to, s.remark, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_time, st.name AS store_name, w.name AS warehouse_name, c.name AS customer_name FROM ch_wx_shop s LEFT JOIN store_info st ON st.id = s.store_id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = s.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN scm_customer c ON c.id = s.customer_id
(s.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.app_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND s.status = #{status} AND s.store_id = #{storeId}
ORDER BY s.id DESC
